items.title: Goldman Sachs opens up $100B Treasury fund to crypto firms
items.summary: Scott Melker discusses how Goldman Sachs (GS) is opening its $100 billion Treasury fund — FTIXX — up to crypto firms, without tokenizing it. "The Daily Wolf with Scott Melker" airs every day at 12:00 p.m. Tune in for your daily dose of all things crypto.

items.title: Long-Term Treasuries Could Be a Good Contrarian Bet
items.summary: Losses have accelerated recently as the yield on the 30-year Treasury has risen almost a half percentage point to 5.6% in the past month.  BlackRock  urged investors to underweight long-term Treasuries, citing “persistent inflation and high debt loads.”  Fuss argues investors should buy intermediate-term debt—he favors five to seven-year maturities—because it offers nearly as much yield as long-term bonds with less risk.

items.title: Will BlackRock Launch an XRP ETF?
items.summary: BlackRock runs the biggest Bitcoin and Ethereum ETFs in the US, yet it skipped every XRP filing deadline while seven rivals already hold billions in the asset. The reason behind that decision could reshape how investors think about XRP's future.
